name: The Way Back
description: The pattern has begun to fold itself down into a shape you could leave through. This is being done for you, and well, and with a certain formality. There is a great deal of goodwill here and none of it will come back with you.

objects.name: the fold
looks: A shape resolving into something a person could go through.
Folded properly, with corners. Somebody does this for a living.
On the other side of it is a room, and a body, and an evening.

objects.name: the goodwill
looks: Enormous, and directed at you, and not remotely personal.
They are pleased you came. They see a lot of people.
It will not survive the trip back and everybody knows that.

ambient: The vault begins the courteous business of closing.
Something waves. It has a great many things to wave with.
The pattern thins, and behind it there is wallpaper.
weather: A cool draught comes through the fold, and it smells like the room you left.
